proof_body:
by
  intro μ _
  exact ⟨ProbabilityTheory.cdf_eq_real μ, ProbabilityTheory.monotone_cdf μ, fun x => (ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ).right_continuous x, ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_cdf_atBot μ, ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_cdf_atTop μ⟩
target_source: ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ], (∀ x, ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ x = μ.real (Set.Iic x)) ∧ Monotone (ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ) ∧ (∀ x, ContinuousWithinAt (ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ) (Set.Ici x) x) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (ProbabilityTheory.cdf μ) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)
